items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: we started off with Johnny LaPorte on the drums... So then we let, uh, then we let, uh, Johnny Laporte go because, I don't think Johnny played well enough.

ctx.x: And then after Crum left, what happened? How did that happen? Well, after Crum left,

the job expired and we decided that we could build Padron and myself. That's when we got Eddie Miller and Almond Hub and we started off with Johnny LaPorte on the drums. And I went up, Bill and I went over to Suburban Gardens that time. No, no, no, it wasn't Suburban, no, I'm sorry, it wasn't Suburban Gardens. It was Beverly Gardens. That was when the guy, the old man that was running the gambling house up there, Beverly Garden, do you remember? What the hell his name was? Beverly Gardens, that was when that was…
